description: Export items in a citation format. Use format "bibtex", "biblatex", "ris", "csljson", "csv" or "tei" for a machine-readable export, or "bib" to render a formatted bibliography in a citation style (set `style`, e.g. "apa", "chicago-note-bibliography", "ieee"). Returns the export as text.

format.description: Export format. "bib" renders a formatted bibliography using `style`.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

itemKeys.description: Keys of the items to export.

style.description: Citation style for format "bib", e.g. "apa", "ieee", "chicago-note-bibliography". Ignored otherwise.

name: zotero_export_items

skippedKeys.description: Requested keys that are not top-level items and were left out.

title: Export citations
